feature_model: Local SHA-bound NLUT vgg_normalised weights; first conv embeds RGB-to-BGR*255 and Caffe mean subtraction. Input raw encoded RGB[0,1], no extra ImageNet normalization; not full NLUT preprocessing reproduction.

projection.fit_scope: 24 source and48 reference descriptors only; in leave-one-owner-out refit all preprocessing excluding held source and both its references

teacher.target: unclipped Y-X; scoring renderer clips X+B(X)U
teacher.normal_equation: B.T B/m +1e-6 D2.T D2/n_D2 +1e-4 I/343; RHS B.T(Y-X)/m, with D2=(d-1)^2 second differences

heads.low_rank_rule: if minimum slope rank<=4 use common0.8*r_min; rank0 predicts weighted mean only and is not reference-learning evidence

admission.fallback: under8 informativepairs: once leave-one-source-owner-out calibration; under3 conditionalgroups: explicitly source-only non-damaged group-mean calibration; check remains unopened

budget.future_phase_accounting: Two cumulative600 CPU-second categories across current and future check work: extraction and learning/render/scoring. Future category allowance =600 minus all recorded prior process-tree CPU in same category; no reset per check stage. Future check entry must consume hash-bound budget ledgers; never edit this frozen fit config after features.

scope: Executable numeric setup only until admission and supervised entry frozen. No check pixels or new acquisition here. Aesthetic failures preserved; research mechanism versus photography remain separate. No architecture/parameter sweep, generator or SA recovery.
